title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it. Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates the two abilities rather than blending them. MoCA is built on Cross-modal Arbitration Block (CAB), which maintains a visual branch and a code branch as two distinct pathways, and a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token. We train MoCA in two stages: a supervised warm-up on self-distilled reasoning trajectories that decomposes visual understanding into explicit steps, followed by reinforce

translated_title: 谁在主导？面向图表到代码生成的令牌级模态仲裁
translated_abstract: 图表到代码生成要求模型读取图表的细粒度视觉细节，并编写可执行的代码来重现它。现有的图表到代码方法要么分别训练视觉和编码能力，要么在图表到代码数据上微调时将这两种能力纠缠在一起。这两种策略都未考虑这两种能力的本质差异，也未考虑在联合优化时产生的干扰。我们提出了MoCA（跨模态仲裁混合），它将这两种能力分离而非混合。MoCA基于跨模态仲裁块（CAB），该块维护视觉分支和代码分支作为两条不同的路径，并有一个轻量级仲裁器在每一层和每个生成的令牌上仲裁它们的相对贡献。我们分两个阶段训练MoCA：首先在自蒸馏推理轨迹上进行监督预热，将视觉理解分解为明确的步骤，然后进行强化学习。
tldr: 本文提出MoCA方法，通过分离视觉与编码能力并引入轻量级仲裁器在令牌级动态权衡两者贡献，解决了图表到代码生成中多模态能力联合训练的干扰问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MoCA, which separates visual and coding abilities and uses a lightweight arbiter for token-level dynamic arbitration, addressing interference in joint training for chart-to-code generation.
